months.title: Start with Goss-textured steel.
months.body: Cold-rolled 3.2% silicon steel is box-annealed into a directional Goss crystal lattice (0.23 mm), coated with a 2–5 µm phosphate glass film, and certified for core-loss grade.
months.parallel: Electromagnetic design freeze and long-lead procurement.

months.title: Slit and shear 45° mitered plates.
months.body: Rotary cutters slit the master coil into stepped widths before CNC lines shear 45-degree mitered laminations so corner flux stays aligned with the low-loss grain.
months.parallel: Winding tooling and tank plate drawings are released.

months.title: Stack the three-limb foundation.
months.body: Laminations are interleaved onto the lower clamping frame to raise three stepped cruciform phase limbs, leaving the top open to receive prefabricated windings.
months.parallel: Tank bottom pan and side walls enter welding in parallel.

months.title: Wind the inner low-voltage coils.
months.body: Electrolytic copper and continuously transposed conductors (CTC) are wrapped in multi-ply kraft paper and wound on mandrels into heavy inner low-voltage cylinders.
months.parallel: High-voltage mandrels and pressboard barriers are prepared.

months.title: Build concentric high-voltage coils.
months.body: With more turns of finer conductor to step up voltage, the high-voltage disc windings are formed as outer cylinders engineered to nest around each LV coil.
months.parallel: Tank stiffener welding and radiator headers continue.

months.title: Fit barriers and press the coils.
months.body: Pressboard cylinders, axial oil-duct spacers, and end rings lock between the LV and HV coils, then undergo thermal shrinking and hydraulic pressing against fault forces.
months.parallel: The welded structural tank approaches leak testing.

months.title: Lower coils, close yoke, braze leads.
months.body: Cranes slip the phase windings over the three core limbs; technicians hand-lace the upper yoke, torque the external tie rods, and braze the phase risers and tap leads.
months.parallel: Porcelain bushings, radiators and conservator are staged.

months.title: Weld, test, and coat the main tank.
months.body: Heavy structural steel plates and vacuum stiffeners are welded, pass pressure-leak inspection, and receive an oil-resistant interior enamel plus a ≥105 µm exterior coat.
months.parallel: Autoclave drying schedule and tanking bay are aligned.

months.title: Vapour-phase dry and tank the core.
months.body: Hot kerosene vapour and deep vacuum extract bound moisture inside the autoclave; cranes immediately seal the bone-dry active part inside the waiting tank.
months.parallel: Gasketed cover, 4 LV and 3 HV bushings are readied.

months.title: Fit cover, bushings, and cooling.
months.body: The cover is bolted down, leads thread through the four LV and three HV porcelain bushings, radiator banks bolt to flank valves, and the offset Buchholz conservator mounts.
months.parallel: Marshalling cabinet and vacuum oil manifold are wired.

months.title: Vacuum oil-fill and run HV tests.
months.body: Heated, degassed insulating oil saturates the evacuated tank under deep vacuum before the unit undergoes turns-ratio, heat-run, and lightning-impulse factory testing.
months.parallel: Pre- and post-test dissolved-gas oil samples are audited.

months.title: Sign off FAT and stamp rating plate.
months.body: After dissolved-gas and partial-discharge records earn customer witness sign-off, the engraved rating plate is riveted to the tank wall for substation dispatch.
months.parallel: Heavy-haul transport and site foundation works proceed.
